div.head: Af 42.1
div.ab: Gif he mægnes hæbbe, ðæt he his gefán beríde ond hine inne besitte, gehealde hine seofan niht inne ⁊ him on ne feohte, gif he inne geðolian wille; ⁊ þonne ymb seofan niht, gif he wille on hond gan ond (his) wæpnu syllan, gehealde hine XXX nihta gesundne ⁊ hine his freondum ⁊ his magum bebeod.

Gif he mægnes hæbbe, þæt he his gefán beride ⁊ inne besitte, gehealde hine VII niht inne ⁊ hine ón ne feohte, gif he inne geðolian wille; ⁊ þonne ymb VII niht, gif he wille on hand gan ⁊ wæpenu sellan, gehealde hine XXX nihta gesundne ⁊ hine his mægum gebodie ⁊ his friondum.

Si uim habeat, ut inimicum (hostem) suum circumueniat et obsideat, custodiat eum septem noctibus intus nec assalliat eum, si ille uelit immorari. Si uelit in manus ire et arma sua reddere, custodiat eum XXX noctibus illesum et parentibus suis eum offerat et amicis.

Gif he mægnes hæbbe, þæt he his gefán beride ⁊ inne besitte, gehealde hine VII niht inne ⁊ hine ón ne feohte, gif he inne geðolian wille; ⁊ þonne ymb VII niht, gif he wille on hand gan ⁊ wæpenu sellan, gehealde hine XXX nihta gesundne ⁊ hine his mægum gebodie ⁊ his friondum.

If he has sufficient force [of numbers] that he may surround his enemy and besiege him inside, let him hold him seven nights therein and not attack him, if he is willing to endure it inside; and after seven nights, if he wishes to turn himself in and give up his weapons, let him hold him unharmed for thirty nights, and summon for him his kin and his friend-group.

If he has power enough to surround his adversary and beseige him in his house, he shall keep him therein seven days, but he shall not fight against him if he [his adversary] will consent to remain inside [his residence]. And if, after seven days, he will submit and hand over his weapons, he shall keep him unscathed for seven days, and send formal notice of his position to his kinsman and friends.

If he has sufficient power to surround his opponent and besiege him there in his house, he is to keep him seven days inside and not fight against him, if he will remain inside; and then after seven days, if he will surrender and give up his weapons, he is to keep him unharmed for 30 days, and send notice about him to his kinsmen and his friends.

Wenn er Macht [genug] hat, dass er seinen Feind [mit Fehde] überziehen und in [dessen] Hofe belagern kann, so halte er ihn drinnen 7 Nächte und fechte nicht gegen ihn, vorausgesetzt, dass jener drinnen [so lange] ausdauern will; und dann nach 7 Nächten, wenn jener sich unterwerfen und [seine] Waffen ausliefern will, bewahre er ihn 30 Nächte unversehrt und melde ihn den Verwandten und Freunden jenes [Verfolgten].

If he has [enough] power to ride [in feud] against his enemy and besiege him in [his] estate, let him keep him inside 7 nights and not fight against him, provided that the other is willing to hold out inside [so long]; and then after 7 nights, if the other is willing to surrender and hand over [his] weapons, let him keep him unharmed for 30 nights and announce him to the kinsmen and friends of that [pursued man].
